create_dataset_map_provider_v2: create a JsonIndexDatasetMapProviderV2 to generate train, val, and test dataset objects for a CO3Dv2 dataset
load_category_dataset: load a single category dataset with frame and sequence annotations from gzipped json files
get_available_subset_names: get the available subset names for a given category folder inside a CO3Dv2 dataset root
extend_test_data_with_known_views: extend test evaluation batches with known training views for models requiring source views as input
get_all_train_cameras: get all training cameras from the JsonIndexDataset for a loaded CO3Dv2 category
